infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ARK Driver uses the camera so you can photograph receipts, invoices and inspection findings and attach them to your expense and maintenance records.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: ARK Driver needs access to your photo library so you can attach existing receipt and document photos to your expense records.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ARK Driver uses your location to show your position on the truck map, calculate routes and mileage for your assigned loads, and attach the location to incident reports you submit.
